# package jsonl

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-capture/jsonl"
```

Package jsonl reads and writes captures as JSON Lines (.mbcap.jsonl), the lossless canonical text encoding of docs/FORMAT.md section 3: one JSON object per line, PDUs as lowercase hex, times as integer ticks.

## Constants

```go
const MaxLineLen = 4 << 20
```

MaxLineLen is the longest line a Reader accepts, newline included.
